instruction: With the dining table on your right and ahead of you, exit the room through the opening to your left, then continue down the hallway to your right. At the end of the hallway, turn left and continue forward. Just before the end of the hallway with the pictures of a young girl and boy on the wall, take a dogleg to the left and enter the bedroom. Walk past the foot of the bed and enter the bathroom to the right of the head of the bed.
